components.name: Vendor onboarding
components.description: Self-service vendor registration, business document upload, approval workflow and catalogue import from CSV files.

components.name: Order management with split orders
components.description: Order splitting by vendor, per-vendor fulfilment states, partial cancellations and returns, and customer-facing order tracking.

components.name: Vendor payouts
components.description: Commission calculation, holding periods, and scheduled payouts to vendors through Stripe Connect with downloadable statements.

components.name: Reviews and ratings moderation
components.description: Verified-purchase product reviews, star ratings, vendor replies and a moderation queue with profanity filtering.
